items.title: Milt Fillius interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 18, 2000
items.q: when Goodman took on Teddy Wilson and Lionel Hampton I didn’t think that was such a big deal.

ctx.x: Let me talk about the music just for a minute. At that time did you or any of your musical — the fans of the music — make a distinction between the white bands and the black bands?

No. And to be honest with you, when Goodman took on Teddy Wilson and Lionel Hampton I didn’t think that was such a big deal. And the Jimmy Lunceford band, God, that really knocked me over. That was a tremendous band, jeez. And showmen.
